Images & files

Joplin exports always include images, attachments and generated files inside the .jex. Exporting several conversations creates one .jex with a single “ChatGPT conversations” notebook; notes follow Joplin’s light or dark theme.

This optional permission only allows downloading images or files hosted outside ChatGPT. It does not choose between links and Base64.
